description: The keywords our agents (the always-on extension sweep) are searching for this organization because a search, by a person in the app or by an agent through viralhunt_search / viralhunt_trending, found next to nothing. Each request: status (queued: no network searched it yet; running: some did; done: all did, the email and webhooks go out within the hour; notified: sent), the networks with searched_at and new_posts, the total new posts, and `fetch`, the search call that reads what was found. Use it instead of asking the same keyword again. Not metered: it spends no search of the daily quota.

status.description: open = not notified yet; done = notified; all (default).

name: viralhunt_search_requests
